title: Advisory Board Member
job_description:
The company was recently accepted into startup programs operated by Google, NVIDIA, Cloudflare, MongoDB, Aiven, Mixpanel, and Deepgram. We are now preparing to begin deliveries across California through our growing locker network and are seeking experienced Advisory Board Members to help guide this critical stage of expansion. We're building the next generation of shipping and last-mile delivery infrastructure by combining AI-powered, multi-carrier shipping technology with a secure smart locker network. Join us for upcoming live events in Malibu and San Francisco.

Advisory Focus

We are particularly interested in advisors with experience in:

Logistics, shipping, supply chain, or last-mile delivery
Parcel lockers and smart infrastructure
Retail real estate, convenience stores, or national location partnerships
Carrier, courier, or postal operations
AI, SaaS, automation, or enterprise technology
Enterprise sales and strategic partnerships
Venture capital, private equity, capital markets, or M&A
Digital advertising and retail media
Government, regulatory, or infrastructure relationships

How You May Contribute

Advisory Board Members may:

Advise on the California delivery launch and locker deployment strategy
Support carrier, retail, real estate, and logistics partnerships
Introduce potential investors, customers, operators, and strategic partners
Help refine go-to-market, revenue, and expansion strategies
Provide guidance on AI shipping technology and last-mile operations
Participate in periodic strategy calls and major company updates

Who We’re Seeking

The ideal advisor is a senior executive, investor, founder, operator, or industry expert with a strong professional network and experience helping early-stage or growth-stage companies scale.

This is a flexible advisory opportunity designed for individuals who can provide targeted guidance, strategic introductions, and practical industry insight.

Why Join Now

This is an opportunity to help shape an emerging logistics platform as it moves from technology development into active delivery operations beyond California. Advisors will have the opportunity to influence the growth of an integrated ecosystem spanning AI-powered shipping, smart lockers, secure package access, last-mile delivery, and national infrastructure expansion.

Engagement terms will be discussed with selected candidates.

Pay: From $59,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote
